scope: CONDITIONAL NORMAL PE/TLS STATIC CFG AND LOCAL SEMANTICS; not original source or whole-program proof
assumptions: Original PE read-only tables and TLS template plus actual normal static initializer algebra are unchanged.
Windows x64 calling convention; valid parser objects; caller output/input and owned allocations do not alias callee private stack scalars.
No arbitrary memory-corruption or adversarial alias guarantee. Finite branch target sets may overapproximate feasible paths.
